notes:
Account background: mid-market retail platform (personalization + search) exploring LLMs for chat returns and product ranking. Primary driver: reduce call-center costs and improve conversion through personalization POC.

Initial meetings: AE intro 2025-11-07, technical deep-dive with SE 2025-11-21 (POC scope agreed).

Key constraints from security & legal: must have EU-only region (data at rest + processing in EU), KMS with EU keys, audit logs retained 7 years for regulated parts of business. They refuse 'regional replicas' that include the US.

What we proposed: Dedicated capacity in eu-west with VPC peering + Private control plane; contingency: hosted API with contractual data residency assurances (our draft). SE demo covered throughput and latency targets (p95 < 120ms for chat with batching).

Customer reaction: positive on latency/cost numbers but legal/security flagged vendor must demonstrate EU-only hosting and evidence of no cross-region failover. They said: "We can't risk cross-border processing — procurement will not approve otherwise."

Recent activity: 2026-02-10 security questionnaire sent; 2026-02-24 we returned answers and offered architecture diagram; 2026-03-05 follow-up call ended with silence from legal; they asked for a signed Commitment Letter for EU-only residency which we cannot provide for hosted product today.

Sales health: stalled. AE notes: "Good technical fit but redline on 'EU-only; no fallback' — product currently supports region routing but not a contractual EU-only guarantee for hosted API. Dedicated/Private might work but customer lacks budget and internal champion to push procurement."
